name: visiting-hours-dream-art-pass1
title: Visiting Hours: the dream scenes' art, pass 1
subtitle: Night 2's house and the dream escape: the cast's dream cut-outs, made from the approved style-E billboards (Lena is round 4-a, your pick). Each has a white sticker border, cut out of the sketchbook, shown here on a lilac-and-lawn backdrop like the dream street.
questions: Do the sticker borders read well as the dream's billboards, or should they be cut tight with no border?
Lena, Theo and Walt at these sizes (Lena 1.72 m, Theo 1.38 m, Walt 1.9 m): right?
notes: Still to come (Flow was busy with another agent's run): the two neighbours and the dog in dream style, the photo wall, the fridge calendar and Theo's drawing. The house builder already picks them up by name once they exist.
The rooms, furniture and street are still pastel boxes: pass 2.
